# Contributing to Enterprise PKI

Thank you for your interest in contributing! This project follows academic and professional standards for Public Key Infrastructures.

## How to Contribute

1. Fork the repository.
2. Create a feature branch (`git checkout -b feature/amazing-feature`).
3. Commit your changes (`git commit -m 'Add amazing feature'`).
4. Push to the branch (`git push origin feature/amazing-feature`).
5. Open a Pull Request.

## Guidelines
- Ensure all OpenSSL configurations follow NIST SP 800-57 guidelines.
- Do not commit any real private keys (`*.key`, `*.pem`, `*.p12`).
- Maintain documentation clarity and English consistency across all files.
